name: task-planner-comfort
postStartCommand: if [ -f /tmp/task-planner-dev.pid ]; then PID=$(cat /tmp/task-planner-dev.pid); if [ -d /proc/$PID ] && [ "$(readlink /proc/$PID/cwd 2>/dev/null)" = "$PWD" ] && ps -p $PID -o stat= | grep -qv 'Z' && tr '\0' ' ' < /proc/$PID/cmdline | grep -q 'next dev -H 0.0.0.0 -p 3000'; then echo dev-server-already-running; else rm -f /tmp/task-planner-dev.pid; fi; fi; if [ ! -f /tmp/task-planner-dev.pid ]; then nohup npm run dev >/tmp/task-planner-dev.log 2>&1 & echo $! >/tmp/task-planner-dev.pid; fi
